body:
**Audit / independent check; no κ claim.** This PR certifies the exact pattern-integer optimum of the whole-helper owner fill for the two latest T74 claims, and compares each published fill with it.

| claim | published fill idle | exact pattern optimum (unique within 1e-12) | gap |
|---|---|---|---|
| [#2374](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2374) on #2322's words, κ = 0.0016971949509 | `{1:21978, 3:8592, 5:2552, 32:1, 48:24560}` | **the same** | 0 (every fill has b ≤ κ + 1e-15) |
| [#2435](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2435) on its copy-buffer-raised words, κ = 0.0016985113437 | `{1:20824, 3:6695, 5:1, 48:25302}` | **`{1:20822, 3:6694, 5:2, 48:25302}`**, root 0.0016985119240 | **+5.80e-10 available** |

- **#2374:** its claim of "an exact window-free-optimal owner fill" is confirmed and strengthened to optimality over *all* legal whole-helper fills. Owner-map work on #2322's words is exactly exhausted; #2402's cap allowed up to 8.1e-10.
- **#2435:** its "exact owner fill for the new inventory" is not the pattern optimum. The optimum moves two rank-1 remainders and one rank-3 remainder into one more rank-5 remainder. It uses, for example, two (32: 9,9,9) bins and 1,156 (48: 4,8,9,9,9,9) bins. The full pattern counts are in the receipt, as a concrete owner-level target worth up to +5.8e-10. Whether it can be realized under #2435's windows and families is **not** checked here.

**Method** (`owner_optimum.py`, standard library only, about 45 s).
- **Relaxation.** Every legal fill places each helper role whole in one idle bin of rank 8, 16, 32 or 48. That is an integer pattern-count vector over the 1,163 width patterns with fixed bin and inventory row sums, so it relaxes every legal fill. This is the #2387 / #2360 relaxation, after #1129.
- **Steps, per claim:**
  1. Certify the published idle multiset's root within ±1e-15 of the claimed κ, using 800-bit enclosures.
  2. Enumerate exactly, by budget-pruned DFS with exact rational basis solves, every integer solution that could beat the claim. Degenerate zero-remainder swaps are handled with an integrality and nonnegativity argument.
  3. Certify the best solution's root.
  4. At (best root) + 1e-15, an exact rational dual, feasible against lower enclosures on all patterns, leaves **zero** integer survivors.
  5. Control at (best root) − 1e-12: the optimum survives, and every survivor has its idle multiset.
- **Inputs.**
  - The #2322 profile and inventory were recounted in #2402.
  - #2435's two words, at head `324d7d35`, were recounted with the #2387 frame-climb rule. They match its reported profile {1:2359, 2:632, 3:330, 4:120, 5:38, 8:8} and inventory {4:33, 5:9, 7:62, 8:90, 9:240}.
  - Idle multisets and κ are as published.
- **Review.** An adversarial AI reviewer could not refute the #2374 part. It reproduced the root to 60 digits and ran a Gomory group-relaxation check, which found the only correction within budget is one empty 32-bin. It also ran more than 48,000 local exchange moves with no improvement; its best alternative is 5.0e-10 below. Its two wording issues are fixed. The #2435 extension uses the same code path.
- **Checks.** `--check-only`, the 3.10 grammar check and the research tests pass. Run on CPython 3.14.4; the registered 3.12 replay was not run.

```sh
python3 -I -B research/t74-owner-fill-optimality/owner_optimum.py
# PASS_T74_OWNER_OPTIMUM pr2374:claim_is_optimum pr2435:optimum_gain=+5.803e-10 unique_within_1e-12 no_new_kappa
```

**Scope.** The pattern relaxation drops windows, families and ports, so the upper bounds cover every legal fill. Realization of any fill is not re-run, neither the claimants' fills nor #2435's optimum. Base: main `0fdd7d82`. Card: `independent-moment`, scope refined; the assignment is the adversarial-audit track, seed 71.

**Credits.**
- #2374 / #2435 / #2349 (Jeremy Kothe) and #2363 (mason-hale): the audited fills.
- #2322 (Vlado Vojdanovski): the words.
- #2360 (Jeremy Diviney) and #1129 (Ali Romman): the pattern-dual relaxation.
- #2387 / #2402 (this author): the tools, vendored with pins.

Prepared with substantial AI assistance (Claude Code, Anthropic, Claude Opus 5.5). No independent human review is claimed. Apache-2.0.

title: Audit (no κ): exact owner-fill optima on the T74 handoff line — #2374's fill is optimal over all fills; #2435's fill leaves +5.8e-10 (pattern optimum certified)
scope_note: This metadata records an audit of all legal owner fills for fixed local words and inventories. It does not bound this composition, which changes both the word/profile and helper inventory. It does not certify this composition.
